summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of the new descending-price auction feature (KDMARCHÉ × O'SCOP). All 7 requested scenarios validated on preview URL. Visitor /encheres, connected member (marie), catalog banner, superadmin panel, settings dialog, form dialog and EN i18n all work as specified.

issues: Countdown label still shows French shorthand 'J-1 23h56' / 'Ends in J-1 23h56' — the 'J-1' token is not translated in EN (should be 'D-1' or full 'Ends in 1d 23h56m'). Minor i18n leak.

Category/type/plan rows expose a 'Désactiver' toggle only (soft-deactivate) — there is no hard-delete affordance. After toggling, the row remains visible marked inactive. Acceptable but the task/UI copy 'la supprimer' misleads: consider hiding inactive items or renaming button to 'Archiver'.

action_items: (low) Translate the 'J-1'/'J+' countdown shorthand in AuctionCard for non-FR locales.
(low) In AuctionSettingsDialog, clarify that delete is a soft-toggle (rename to Archiver/Activer) OR expose a permanent delete on inactive rows.
critical_code_review_comments: AuctionSettingsDialog: taxonomy toggle is destructive-looking ('Désactiver') but reversible — verify backend endpoint semantics match UI copy.
AuctionsPage.jsx correctly gates bid/accept UI and displays floor-masked LIVE auction without provenance badge — good.
AuctionCard countdown formatter is FR-locked (J-1, h, m). Consider passing locale.
seed_data_creation: Created transient auction category 'TEST_iter92_cat' via UI, then toggled off (Désactiver). Row remains as inactive (soft-delete) — safe (TEST_ prefixed, easy to clean). Marie placed exactly 1 bid on AUC-20260913-4D07B1 (120→118€, credits 100→90) as instructed; auction still LIVE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo state after this run: LIVE auction AUC-20260913-4D07B1 now at 118.00 €/1180 cr with 1 bid; marie has 90 auction credits remaining. Category 'TEST_iter92_cat' left in Inactive state in auction taxonomy (soft-deactivated).
